notes.title: Controls
notes.content:
[h2]Spells can be selected in two ways:[/h2][p][/p][p][b]Hold the Q key briefly[/b] to bring up the spell bar, then use [b]A, S, D[/b] to navigate or simply [b]left-click[/b] on a spell.[/p][p]Or use [b]F2 for Arcane Bolt[/b], [b]F3 for Arcane Shield[/b], and [b]F4 for Time Wrap[/b] directly.[/p][p]💡 [i]Note: This is the first iteration of the keybindings. Full keyboard/mouse and controller support will improve usability in future versions.[/i][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h3]■ Character Attributes[/h3][p]You can allocate points under [b]Primary Attributes / Skills[/b] on your character screen. For a Mage, we recommend:[/p][p]A. [b]Arcana[/b] – Grants +1 HP, +1 Tempo, and +3 Focus per rank[/p][p]B. [b]Finesse[/b] – Grants +2 HP, +2 Tempo, and +1 Focus per rank[/p][p]If survivability is a priority, invest in [b]Vigor[/b], which grants +4 HP and +1 Tempo per rank.[/p][p]🧪 [i]Many items also boost these attributes depending on their rarity and stats.[/i][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h3]■ Combat Basics[/h3][p][b]Main rule:[/b] If you run out of [b]Tempo[/b], end your turn by pressing [b]ENTER[/b] or clicking the [b]End Turn[/b] button.[/p][p]Your character can only move or act as long as they have Tempo remaining.[/p][p]🏃‍♂️ [i]Tip: If you're near an Exit (marked with a green arrow), you can flee to the adjacent map.[/i][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h3]■ Spell Usage[/h3][p][/p][p][b]Arcane Bolt[/b] – A magical projectile that can hit enemies even without Line of Sight.[/p][p]→ Press [b]F2[/b], or hold [b]Q[/b], navigate with [b]A/S/D[/b][/p][p]→ Press [b]Q[/b] again to enter targeting mode[/p][p]→ Rotate target with [b]A/D[/b], cast with [b]F
[/b][/p][p][b]Arcane Shield[/b] – Currently self-cast only. Grants both [b]physical[/b] and [b]magical[/b] protection.[/p][p]→ Use [b]F3[/b] or hold [b]Q[/b], navigate to the spell[/p][p]→ Target yourself, confirm with [b]F
[/b][/p][p][b]Time Wrap[/b] – A spell with dual-purpose effects.[/p][p]→ Cast on enemies to [b]increase[/b] their Tempo cost[/p][p]→ Cast on yourself to [b]reduce[/b] your Tempo cost[/p][p]→ Use the [i]same selection method[/i] as above[/p][p][/p][p][b]Envigoration[/b][/p][p]→ Heals your character[/p][p]→ Buffs Vigor (more HP = more survivability)[/p][p]Perfect for surviving swarms of goblins and the Orc Shaman.[/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h3]■ Targeting & Hit Chance[/h3][p]When targeting (rotating with [b]A/D[/b]), a stats window appears next to the enemy.[/p][p]⚠️ [i]Note: The window disappears if you move the mouse.[/i][/p][p]The [b]percentage[/b] displayed indicates your [b]hit chance[/b].[/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h3]■ Additional Tips[/h3][p]Lootables such as equipment and [b]consumables[/b] (e.g. [i]potions[/i]) are essential.[/p][p]You can use [b]potions before or during combat[/b].[/p][p][b]You cannot change gear while in combat.[/b][/p]

tags.feature: Hold the Q key briefly to bring up the spell bar, then use A, S, D to navigate or simply left-click on a spell.
Or use F2 for Arcane Bolt, F3 for Arcane Shield, and F4 for Time Wrap directly.
You can allocate points under Primary Attributes / Skills on your character screen.
A. Arcana – Grants +1 HP, +1 Tempo, and +3 Focus per rank
B. Finesse – Grants +2 HP, +2 Tempo, and +1 Focus per rank
If survivability is a priority, invest in Vigor, which grants +4 HP and +1 Tempo per rank.
If you run out of Tempo, end your turn by pressing ENTER or clicking the End Turn button.
Your character can only move or act as long as they have Tempo remaining.
Arcane Bolt – A magical projectile that can hit enemies even without Line of Sight.
Press F2, or hold Q, navigate with A/S/D
Press Q again to enter targeting mode
Rotate target with A/D, cast with F
Arcane Shield – Currently self-cast only. Grants both physical and magical protection.
Use F3 or hold Q, navigate to the spell
Target yourself, confirm with F
Time Wrap – A spell with dual-purpose effects.
Cast on enemies to increase their Tempo cost
Cast on yourself to reduce your Tempo cost
Use the same selection method as above
Envigoration
Heals your character
Buffs Vigor (more HP = more survivability)
Perfect for surviving swarms of goblins and the Orc Shaman.
When targeting (rotating with A/D), a stats window appears next to the enemy.
The percentage displayed indicates your hit chance.
Lootables such as equipment and consumables (e.g. potions) are essential.
You can use potions before or during combat.
You cannot change gear while in combat.
